content: 1 Then answered Baldad the Suhite, & sayde: 2 Power & feare is with him aboue, that maketh peace (sittinge) in his hynesse, 3 whose men of warre are innumerable, and whose light aryseth ouer all. 4 But how maye a man copared vnto God, be iustified? Or, how can he be clene, that is borne of a woman? 5 Beholde, the Moone shyneth nothinge in comparison to him, & the starres are vnclene in his sight. 6 How moch more the, ma, that is but corrupcion: and the sonne of man, which is but a worme?
